item.title: Montana Right‑to‑Try Law: Early Drug Access vs Ethics
item.description: Montana's right‑to‑try law lets biotech firms sell experimental drugs after minimal testing, igniting debate over safety, ethics, and industry impact.

item.title: Montana Expands Right‑to‑Try for Kids with Rare Disease
